auth.title: Sign-in
auth.login.title: Sign in with Telegram
auth.login.body: Open the console from the owner bot’s menu button, or use the sign-in link the bot sends you.
auth.dev.title: Developer sign-in
auth.dev.body: Sign in as any Telegram account in the development database. Works only on a DEBUG backend with DASHBOARD_DEV_LOGIN on.
auth.dev.invalidId: Enter a Telegram id: digits only
